description: This file defines the Phone validation rule class used within the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract rule and implements validation logic using a regular expression to verify phone number formats.

classes.name: Phone
classes.description: A validation class that checks whether a given input conforms to allowed phone number characters using a regex pattern.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input to check if it matches the phone number regex pattern or is empty.
